channel.title: IBM Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by IBM Corporation (ibm).

item.title: CVE-2026-11537 · 4.3 MEDIUM — IBM WebSphere Application Server prior to 9.0.5.29 and 8.5.5.31 are affected by multiple vulnerabilities
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server 9.0, and 8.5 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information about the file system through the FileTransfer servlet.

item.title: CVE-2026-11381 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM MQ for HPE NonStop is vulnerable to a denial of service issue
item.description: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code due to improper validation of message distribution list structures.

item.title: CVE-2026-11378 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM MQ queue manager is vulnerable to remote code execution
item.description: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code due to an integer overflow in distribution list processing.

item.title: CVE-2026-11375 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM MQ queue manager is vulnerable to remote code execution
item.description: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code due to a stack buffer overflow when processing XA transaction identifiers.

item.title: CVE-2026-10858 · 9.9 CRITICAL — IBM MQ for HPE NonStop is vulnerable to a denial of service attack
item.description: IBM MQ for HPE NonStop 8.1.0 through 8.1.0.40 could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code due to a heap buffer underflow when processing multi-segment messages.

item.title: CVE-2026-10853 · 7.5 HIGH — IBM MQ queue manager is vulnerable to remote code execution
item.description: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated attacker with cluster access to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code due to improper validation of cluster command message lengths.

item.title: CVE-2026-10841 · 4.2 MEDIUM — Multiple security vulnerabilities may affect IBM WebSphere Liberty that is shipped with IBM CICS TX Advanced.
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5, 9.0, and Liberty are vulnerable to HTTP request smuggling.

item.title: CVE-2026-10751 · 7.5 HIGH — IBM MQ Java messaging is vulnerable to remote code execution
item.description: IBM MQ Java and JMS client libraries could allow an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on client applications due to a deserialization filter bypass in exception handling.

item.title: CVE-2026-10747 · 10 CRITICAL 🌩️ — IBM MQ Appliance is affected by a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in protocol message processing
item.description: IBM MQ Appliance could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code due to a heap buffer overflow in protocol message processing before authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-10744 · 7.5 HIGH — IBM MQ for HPE NonStop is vulnerable to a issue in MQINQ request validation
item.description: IBM MQ for HPE NonStop 8.1.0 through 8.1.0.40 could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially escalate privileges due to an integer overflow in MQINQ request validation.

item.title: CVE-2026-10575 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM MQ queue manager is vulnerable to remote code execution
item.description: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially escalate privileges due to a heap buffer overflow when processing MQPUT operations with malformed distribution headers.
